title: [Theme/UI]: Authentic 1982 Vector Graphics Monochromatic Green Wireframe Theme & Glow Matrix
body:
## Problem
Current platform themes feature rich multi-color palettes and raster gradients. However, the golden age of arcade gaming (1979–1983) was defined by vector beam monitors (such as *Battlezone*, *Asteroids*, *Tempest*, and *Star Wars*), which used razor-sharp phosphorescent vector line rendering. ArcadeVerse currently lacks an authentic monochromatic vector wireframe aesthetic.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Vector Wireframe CSS Architecture (`assets/css/theme-vector-green.css`):**
   - Implements a dedicated vector palette: Phosphor Green `#00ff66`, High-Beam Line `#55ff99`, and Deep Electron Black `#020d05`.
   - Replaces solid cards and containers with high-contrast 1px neon wireframe borders and translucent interior alpha fills (`rgba(0, 255, 102, 0.03)`).
2. **Phosphor Persistence Beam Glow:**
   - Multi-layered CSS text and box glows (`drop-shadow(0 0 6px #00ff66)`) simulating vector beam bloom and slow phosphor cathode decay.
3. **Integration with Theme Selector:**
   - Registers `vector-green` inside `theme-customizer.js` with instant stylesheet swapping and `localStorage` persistence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Crisp 1px neon wireframe rendering across all hub cards, navigation bars, and modals.
- [ ] Complies with WCAG AA contrast standards (> 4.5:1 ratio between text and background).
- [ ] Zero performance degradation or layout shifts during theme switching.

title: [Theme/UI]: Game Boy DMG-01 4-Shade Monochromatic Olive Green LCD Ghosting Theme
body:
## Problem
Handheld gaming enthusiasts love the nostalgic aesthetic of the original 1989 Nintendo Game Boy (DMG-01). The platform currently offers modern dark and neon themes, but has no authentic 4-color dot-matrix LCD theme.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Authentic 4-Shade LCD Palette (`assets/css/theme-gameboy-dmg.css`):**
   - Enforces the exact physical Game Boy DMG color matrix:
     - Darkest Olive: `#0f380f`
     - Dark Olive: `#306230`
     - Light Olive: `#8bac0f`
     - Lightest Background: `#9bbc0f`
2. **Subtle Dot-Matrix LCD Sub-Pixel Grid:**
   - Renders a lightweight, non-intrusive repeating CSS pattern (`background-size: 2px 2px`) simulating the physical square pixel grid of early STN LCD panels.
3. **Ghosting Decay Filter (Optional Toggle):**
   - Provides a toggleable CSS transition effect simulating the slow pixel response time and ghosting trails characteristic of 1980s LCD screens.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Complete platform restyling restricted exclusively to the 4 official DMG olive shades.
- [ ] Clean integration into the theme selector with zero external image textures.
- [ ] Fully legible text and buttons across desktop and mobile screens.

title: [Enhancement/UI]: Dynamic Canvas Cursor Particle Trail Studio & Retro Comet Spark Tail
body:
## Problem
Navigating the catalog on desktop utilizes the standard operating system cursor, which feels mundane on a vibrant retro arcade website. Physical arcade cabinets and classic flash game hubs featured playful, dynamic mouse trails.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Interactive Cursor Particle Engine (`assets/js/cursor-trails.js`):**
   - Renders high-performance particle trails following pointer coordinates using pure Canvas 2D overlay.
   - Built-in trail styles: `Retro 8-Bit Pixel Sparkles`, `Neon Comet Tail`, `Rainbow Starlight`, and `Electric Arc Discharges`.
2. **Physics Damping & Velocity Scaling:**
   - Particle emission count and velocity scale dynamically with pointer movement speed; stationary cursors emit gentle ambient twinkling.
3. **Performance & Accessibility Guardrails:**
   - Uses a pre-allocated object pool of 60 particles with zero per-frame garbage collection.
   - Automatically halts rendering and unbinds listeners when `prefers-reduced-motion` is active or on touch-only mobile devices.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Silky-smooth 60 FPS trail tracking with zero mouse pointer lag.
- [ ] User preference toggle in settings to enable/disable or choose trail styles.
- [ ] Automatic teardown when modal games launch to prevent distracting active gameplay.

title: [Theme/UI]: Cyberpunk Neon Sunset Synthwave Outrun Theme Studio
body:
## Problem
While ArcadeVerse has high-tech cyber themes, it lacks a dedicated 1980s Synthwave / Outrun aesthetic featuring vibrant tropical sunset gradients and neon wireframe horizon grids.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Outrun Synthwave Color Matrix (`assets/css/theme-synthwave-outrun.css`):**

2. **Animated Wireframe Horizon Grid:**
   - Pure CSS perspective grid background with an infinite forward-scrolling horizon line beneath the catalog header.
3. **Retro Duotone Card Glows:**
   - Catalog cards feature cyan-to-magenta duotone border glows and retro angled italic typography accents.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Vibrant Synthwave / Outrun styling across all hub components, tables, and buttons.
- [ ] Smooth CSS keyframe horizon animation respecting reduced-motion media queries.
- [ ] Registered seamlessly inside `theme-customizer.js` with instant switching.

title: [Feature/Catalog]: Virtualized Game Card Grid Scroller for Instant Mobile & Low-End DOM Performance
body:
## Problem
With over 125 games in the repository, rendering 125+ complex card DOM elements simultaneously (each with thumbnail images, tag badges, buttons, and event listeners) causes DOM bloat, high memory consumption, and frame drops when scrolling on budget mobile devices.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Windowed Grid Virtualization (`assets/js/virtual-grid.js`):**
   - Implements a pure Vanilla JS windowed virtualization engine that calculates viewport scroll position and visible row heights.
   - Only mounts cards currently in the visible viewport plus 1 buffer row above and below (approx. 8 to 16 active DOM cards at any time).
2. **Absolute Transform Positioning & Total Height Spacer:**
   - Maintains an invisible scroll container matching the full calculated height of all 125+ cards, positioning active cards with `transform: translateY()` for GPU-accelerated scrolling.
3. **Zero-Lag Search & Filter Compatibility:**
   - Seamlessly recalculates virtualized indices whenever the user types in the search bar or selects category filter chips.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] DOM node count remains constant (< 30 card nodes) regardless of total game count.
- [ ] Rock-solid 60 FPS scrolling on mobile devices without blank flickering or layout shifts.
- [ ] 100% Vanilla JS without external libraries (e.g. no React Virtualized / TanStack).

title: [Enhancement/UI]: Floating Retro Arcade Marquee Header Banner with Dynamic Sound Waves
body:
## Problem
The top hero section of the hub currently uses standard flat web typography, which does not evoke the visual grandeur of an illuminated physical arcade cabinet marquee.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Cabinet Marquee Component (`assets/js/marquee-header.js`):**
   - Renders a styled physical arcade cabinet marquee frame across the top banner with illuminated back-lit acrylic textures and metallic rivet borders.
2. **Dynamic Chasing Bulb Neon Marquee:**
   - Perimeter marquee chase bulbs with customizable animation modes (sequential chase, alternating blink, sound-reactive pulse).
3. **Responsive Scaling & Performance:**
   - Automatically adapts dimensions smoothly across widescreen monitors, tablets, and narrow mobile viewports using CSS container queries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Authentic retro arcade cabinet aesthetic rendered in pure CSS3 and SVG.
- [ ] Keyframe chase lights pause when user prefers reduced motion or tabs out.
- [ ] Clean integration into `index.html` without breaking existing navigation.

title: [Theme/A11y]: High-Legibility OpenDyslexic & Atkinson Hyperlegible Font Theme Switcher
body:
## Problem
Pixelated retro typography and tight monospace fonts, while stylistically pleasing, present severe reading challenges for users with dyslexia, low vision, or cognitive reading difficulties.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Accessible Typographic Mode (`assets/js/a11y-font-switcher.js`):**
   - An accessibility toggle providing instant switching to high-legibility typographic profiles (OpenDyslexic or Atkinson Hyperlegible).
2. **Enhanced Letter Spacing & Line Height Rules:**
   - Applies generous character tracking (+0.08em), widened word spacing (+0.16em), and 1.6x line heights to eliminate visual crowding.
3. **Full Platform Coverage:**
   - Re-styles game descriptions, contributor leaderboards, rules checklists, and modal dialogs with guaranteed text wrapping and zero button truncation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Instant 1-click toggle in accessibility settings with `localStorage` persistence.
- [ ] Verified legibility across all catalog cards and the Hall of Fame leaderboard.
- [ ] Zero layout breakage or clipped text containers when legibility mode is active.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Procedural Background Ambient Arcade Hall Chatter & Coin Drop Soundscape Generator
body:
## Problem
Browsing the ArcadeVerse catalog is currently completely silent. Visitors browsing games miss the bustling energy, distant chiptune melodies, and metallic coin rattles of a busy physical arcade hall.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Procedural Arcade Hall Ambience (`assets/js/ambient-arcade-hall.js`):**
   - Generates authentic, continuous arcade parlor background soundscapes using pure Web Audio API without streaming large pre-recorded audio files.
2. **Procedural Soundscape Layers:**
   - Low-frequency crowd murmur (filtered Brownian/pink noise).
   - Random distant arcade beeps (sporadic high-frequency square wave arpeggios).
   - Occasional coin drop rattle and button microswitch clicks.
3. **Interactive Volume & Ambient Preset Controls:**
   - Ambient sound controls in the navbar (`Off`, `Quiet Background`, `Full Arcade Energy`) with automatic muting when a game modal is launched.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Generates rich, relaxing retro arcade soundscape using under 1% CPU.
- [ ] Seamlessly pauses ambient audio whenever a player launches a game to prevent audio conflict.
- [ ] Off by default; requires explicit user toggle to respect browser audio policies.

title: [Enhancement/UX]: Keyboard-Only Fast Arcade Navigation & Vim-Style Modal Quick-Jumps
body:
## Problem
Power users and accessibility enthusiasts must constantly use the mouse to search, filter, and launch games. A fast keyboard-driven shortcut layer would make browsing much faster.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Arcade Keyboard Shortcut Engine (`assets/js/keyboard-quickjump.js`):**
   - Global keyboard listener supporting intuitive single-key shortcuts:
     - `/`: Focus search input bar immediately.
     - `j` / `k` or `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp`: Navigate through game cards with high-visibility neon outline focus rings.
     - `Enter`: Launch currently highlighted game.
     - `f`: Toggle favorite on active game.
     - `1` through `8`: Jump directly between category filters (Action, Puzzle, Retro, etc.).
     - `?`: Open shortcut cheat-sheet modal.
2. **Input Context Awareness:**
   - Automatically suppresses single-key shortcuts when typing inside form inputs or when an active game iframe is focused.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Complete keyboard-only navigable catalog experience without touching the mouse.
- [ ] Beautiful retro keyboard shortcut overlay opened via `?`.
- [ ] Zero event conflict with game keys inside the active game iframe.

title: [Theme/UI]: Amber Phosphor CRT Monochrome Terminal Theme Studio
body:
## Problem
Many retro computing fans prefer the warm, warm-glow aesthetic of amber CRT monitors (such as the legendary DEC VT220, IBM 3270, and Apple II monochrome monitors) which are known for reducing eye strain during night sessions.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Amber Monochrome CSS Architecture (`assets/css/theme-amber-terminal.css`):**
   - Palette: Warm Amber Glow `#ffb000`, Bright Highlight `#ffd266`, Muted Ochre `#996600`, and Deep Dark `#120a00`.
2. **Warm Phosphor Halo & Decay:**
   - Custom CSS text-shadow and border glows creating authentic warm phosphor halos around all interface text.
3. **Blinking Block Terminal Cursors:**
   - Replaces standard text carets with authentic blinking amber solid block cursors (`█`) in search inputs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Distinctive, warm amber monochrome aesthetic across all platform views.
- [ ] Tested and verified contrast compliance for comfortable dark-room gaming.
- [ ] Integrated into `theme-customizer.js` with instant switching.

title: [Feature/Gamification]: In-Browser Retro Stamp Card & Daily Play Loyalty Punchcard
body:
## Problem
While ArcadeVerse tracks daily streaks, players lack a tactile, visual collection mechanism celebrating daily visits in a retro physical format.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Retro Paper Loyalty Punchcard UI (`assets/js/arcade-punchcard.js`):**
   - An interactive physical-styled 7-day loyalty punchcard drawer rendered with vintage textured paper borders and stamped ink slots.
2. **Animated Ink Stamping Ceremony:**
   - When completing the daily play goal, plays a satisfying mechanical stamp sound (`thump!`) with a randomized ink rotation angle and slight smudge imperfection.
3. **Day 7 Holographic Completion Badge:**
   - Completing a full 7-day punchcard unlocks an exclusive local holographic punchcard badge and resets the card for the following week.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 100% client-side persistence in `localStorage` under `arcadeverse_punchcard`.
- [ ] Procedural Web Audio mechanical stamp sound effect with zero audio files.
- [ ] Responsive drawer accessible from the daily streak counter in the header.

title: [Enhancement/UI]: Interactive Mini-Game Card Hover Quick-Peek Micro-Canvases
body:
## Problem
Browsing games requires clicking open the full game modal to see what gameplay looks like, as game cards currently display only static screenshots or category icons.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Lightweight Hover Micro-Canvas (`assets/js/card-quickpeek.js`):**
   - When hovering over a game card for more than 400ms on desktop, replaces the static thumbnail with a lightweight procedural micro-canvas animation depicting core game mechanics (e.g. bouncing paddle/ball for brick breaker, moving neon worm for snake, falling blocks for puzzle).
2. **Instant Micro-Animation Generators:**
   - Implements 6 archetypal procedural micro-animations mapped to game categories (`Action/Shooter`, `Brick Breaker`, `Snake/Runner`, `Puzzle`, `Maze/Dungeon`, `Sports/Racing`).
3. **Zero Resource Overhead when Not Hovered:**
   - Micro-canvases are created and destroyed on demand with `cancelAnimationFrame` upon `pointerleave` to preserve battery life and CPU.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Micro-animations start smoothly after 400ms hover delay with zero memory leaks.
- [ ] Completely disabled on mobile/touchscreen devices to preserve mobile performance.
- [ ] Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` by displaying static preview only.

title: [Theme/UI]: Solarized Cyber Dark & Cyber Light Dual Thematic Mode Studio
body:
## Problem
Players who use laptops outdoors or in brightly lit rooms struggle with dark cyber themes. Furthermore, existing light themes often produce harsh glare without carefully calibrated contrast ratios.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Scientifically Calibrated Solarized Palette (`assets/css/theme-solarized-cyber.css`):**
   - Adapts Ethan Schoonover's precision Solarized color system for cyber arcade UI:
     - Dark Mode: Base03 `#002b36`, Base02 `#073642`, Cyan `#2aa198`, Yellow `#b58900`.
     - Light Mode: Base3 `#fdf6e3`, Base2 `#eee8d5`, Cyan `#2aa198`, Orange `#cb4b16`.
2. **Dual Mode Sub-Toggle:**
   - Provides a dedicated Solarized Dark / Solarized Light toggle within the theme customizer.
3. **Mathematically Guaranteed Contrast:**
   - Guarantees strict WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast compliance across all text labels, badges, and button states in both lighting conditions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Flawless visual clarity under direct ambient daylight and in dark rooms.
- [ ] Smooth color transitions with zero component layout shifts.
- [ ] Fully integrated with `theme-customizer.js`.

title: [Feature/UX]: Fullscreen Arcade Theater Immersion Mode with Darkened Backdrop & Spotlight
body:
## Problem
When playing a game inside the modal, background navbar buttons, search bars, and colorful catalog elements remain visible in the peripheral vision, distracting the player from fast-paced action.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Theater Immersion Controller (`assets/js/theater-mode.js`):**
   - Adds an "Arcade Theater Mode" toggle button to the game modal header.
   - When activated, dims the entire browser viewport behind the game to 96% deep black opacity with a soft CSS backdrop blur (`backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`).
2. **Cabinet Spotlight Overhead Projection:**
   - Casts an authentic radial spotlight gradient centered on the active game canvas, simulating the overhead marquee light of an authentic arcade cabinet.
3. **Keyboard Quick-Toggle & Escape Handling:**
   - Quick toggle via `T` key; automatically exits theater mode cleanly upon `Escape` or modal close.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Seamless transition into darkened theater immersion mode with zero frame drops.
- [ ] Game controls and audio continue uninterrupted during mode toggling.
- [ ] Persistent setting in `localStorage` remember player preference.

title: [Enhancement/UI]: Floating Glassmorphic Quick-Action Bottom Dock for Mobile Viewports
body:
## Problem
On modern tall smartphones, reaching the top navbar buttons (Search, Favorites, Daily Streak, Theme Settings) with one hand is ergonomically difficult, leading to awkward thumb stretching.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Ergonomic Floating Bottom Navigation Dock (`assets/js/mobile-dock.js`):**
   - Automatically appears on screen widths under 768px.
   - Fixed at the bottom of the viewport with safe-area padding for mobile home-bar swipe indicators (`env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`).
2. **Frosted Glassmorphic Styling:**
   - Styled with frosted glassmorphism (`backdrop-filter: blur(14px)`, `background: rgba(18, 18, 30, 0.75)`, neon border accents).
3. **Thumb-Friendly Action Buttons:**
   - 5 essential thumb buttons: `Home`, `Search`, `Favorites`, `Streak`, and `Theme Studio` with animated micro-bounce icons on tap.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Automatically hides on desktop (> 768px) and mounts cleanly on mobile.
- [ ] Seamless integration with existing search inputs and favorites drawers.
- [ ] Respects device safe-area insets on iOS and Android devices.

title: [Theme/UI]: Retro Vaporwave Pastel Aesthetics & Windows 95 Vintage OS Theme
body:
## Problem
Retro aesthetics encompass multiple eras. The mid-90s Vaporwave and Windows 95 aesthetic (classic beveled windows, teal desktops, pastel pinks) is widely beloved in retrogaming culture but missing from ArcadeVerse.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Vaporwave / Win95 Palette (`assets/css/theme-vaporwave-win95.css`):**
   - Classic Windows 95 Teal desktop: `#008080`.
   - Vintage 3D Beveled Grey: `#c0c0c0` with `#ffffff` top-left highlights and `#808080` bottom-right shadow borders.
   - Vaporwave Pastel Accents: Lavender `#b57bee`, Pastel Pink `#ff94c2`, and Sky Blue `#70d6ff`.
2. **Authentic 3D Inset / Outset Buttons:**
   - Re-styles buttons and cards with classic 2px 3D bevels that physically depress on click.
3. **Retro Title Bars with Close Box:**
   - Renders classic navy gradient title bars with pixelated `X` close buttons on modal windows.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Distinctive, charming 90s vintage OS aesthetic across all hub components.
- [ ] Tactile 3D button press animations in pure CSS.
- [ ] Clean integration into `theme-customizer.js` with instant switching.

title: [Feature/Audio]: Customizable UI Interaction Click Sound Packs with Zero-Asset Synthesis
body:
## Problem
UI interactions (button clicks, tab switches, favorite toggles) currently play the same hardcoded sound effect or remain silent, offering players no choice in auditory feedback.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Synthesized UI Click Sound Packs (`assets/js/ui-click-packs.js`):**
   - Synthesizes 4 distinct tactile sound packs programmatically via Web Audio API:
     - `Mechanical Keyboard`: Authentic Cherry MX Blue tactile switch clicks.
     - `Arcade Microswitch`: Crisp physical joystick microswitch snaps.
     - `Bubble Pop`: Playful hollow aquatic popping bubble sounds.
     - `Sci-Fi Hologram`: Subtle futuristic high-frequency chimes.
2. **Debounced Global Event Listener:**
   - Attaches a single delegated click listener to `data-sound-trigger` and button elements with a 50ms debounce to prevent audio stacking during fast clicking.
3. **Theme Settings Selector:**
   - Sound pack selection dropdown in the theme customizer with instant preview button and volume slider.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 100% procedural sound synthesis without a single external audio file.
- [ ] Under 0.1ms execution time per click with zero UI thread freezing.
- [ ] Respects global sound mute settings in `localStorage`.

title: [Enhancement/Catalog]: Multi-Criteria Game Comparison Drawer with Side-by-Side Spec Matrix
body:
## Problem
With over 120 games across diverse categories, players and developers often struggle to decide which games to play or analyze without launching them individually.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Interactive Comparison Drawer (`assets/js/game-comparator-drawer.js`):**
   - Allows users to select up to 3 games (via a new "Compare" button on cards) and open a slide-up comparison drawer.
2. **Side-by-Side Metric Matrix:**
   - Compares key attributes side-by-side: Category, Difficulty Rating, Input Controls (Keyboard, Mouse, Touch, Gamepad), High Score records, Author credits, and Tech Stack details.
3. **1-Click Launch from Matrix:**
   - Direct launch buttons for each compared game and 1-click "Clear Comparison" reset.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth slide-up drawer animation on both desktop and mobile viewports.
- [ ] Clean keyboard accessibility with `Escape` key dismissal.
- [ ] Zero interference with default game launch modals.

title: [Theme/UI]: Pitch Black OLED Pure Dark Mode for Battery Saving on Mobile Displays
body:
## Problem
Standard dark modes use dark charcoal or grey backgrounds (`#121212` or `#1a1a2e`). On modern OLED/AMOLED mobile screens, pixels only truly turn off when displaying true pitch black (`#000000`). Using true black significantly cuts display battery consumption during extended mobile gaming sessions.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Pure OLED Black Stylesheet (`assets/css/theme-oled-black.css`):**
   - Enforces true `#000000` on body, containers, card backgrounds, and modals.
2. **Crisp 1px Neon Wireframe Accents:**
   - Uses razor-sharp 1px high-contrast borders (Electric Lime `#39ff14`, Cyan `#00ffff`) so elements remain distinct without requiring grey background fill blocks.
3. **Battery Saving Verification:**
   - Maximizes the percentage of turned-off pixels (> 85% of total screen area is true `#000000`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 100% pure black `#000000` backgrounds across the entire platform.
- [ ] Maximum visual clarity with vibrant neon contrast lines.
- [ ] Seamless integration into `theme-customizer.js` with zero layout shifts.

title: [Feature/Social]: Shareable Game Challenge Deep-Link URL Generator with Target Score Badges
body:
## Problem
When a player scores a great run, sharing a generic game link only opens the game at score 0. There is no built-in way to challenge a friend to beat a specific score target.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Challenge Link Generator (`assets/js/challenge-deep-link.js`):**
   - Adds a "Challenge a Friend" button on game over screens and game cards.
   - Encodes target score and challenger name into a shareable URL: `?game=cyber-runner&target=3500&challenger=Debasmita`.
2. **In-Game Challenge Banner HUD:**
   - When opened via a challenge link, displays an animated banner at the top of the game: `"CHALLENGE: Beat Debasmita's 3,500 pts!"` with real-time target distance tracking.
3. **Victory Celebration Overlay:**
   - If the player surpasses the target score during the run, immediately triggers a celebratory neon banner ("TARGET SURPASSED!") with confetti VFX.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Seamlessly parses challenge URL query parameters on game launch.
- [ ] Generates instant shareable links with 1-click clipboard copy.
- [ ] Clean fallback to standard game play if query parameters are missing or invalid.
